items.title: Pierre Boussaguet interviewed by Matthieu Jaffre, Aix en Provence, France, July 28, 2020
items.q: And the next day I was here in Aix en Provence with Jean Paul where we’re at — and at the end of the night he told me the same thing.

ctx.x: colleagues, he said, “You see, it doesn’t matter where you’re playing. You could be in a big stadium, you could be in a very small, tiny joint, you have no idea of who is in the audience listening.” So that’s why you have to be focused on the music.

For sure. In my list I didn’t mention one particular musician that you worked with for several years that you really admire, it’s Ray Brown. And I know that the owner of this place, Jean-Paul Artero gave you an advice in the 80s to maybe work with him, so it’s part of your relationship.
